sourceSentences: If the bolt passes through Acceleration Gate, it becomes supercharged: increasing its damage by 40% as well as its speed, range and explosion radius.
Upon touching Acceleration Gate, the enhanced missile gains its remaining range equal to [ 1600 units - travelled distance of the standard missile ].
This means that the range of the enhanced Shock Blast is always the same, regardless of how early or late it interacted with Acceleration Gate.
Supercharging the Shock Blast as soon as possible, however, will improve its average speed significantly.
For this, Jayce must stand inside or very close to the Acceleration Gate, or place it very close to himself right after Shock Blast's cast time.
Jayce and allied champions can move through the gate to gain bonus movement speed that decays over 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing continuously while within the gate.
Hyper Charge resets Jayce's basic attack timer.
Jayce roots the target enemy over the cast time, then swings his hammer at them to deal magic damage, capped against monsters, and knock them back 600 units.
Jayce is unable to cast To the Skies! or Shock Blast for 0.4 seconds after Thundering Blow's cast time.
Lightning Field can be cast during the dash.
Whenever Jayce switches between either Transform Mercury Hammer or Transform Mercury Cannon, he gains ghosting and 30 bonus movement speed for 0.75 seconds.
The enhanced attack will not be consumed if it is parried (dodge, block, blind, and Riposte).
Both Transform on-hit effects have no set duration and will only be consumed when Jayce either lands a basic attack or switches stances.

L'un des combos de base de Jayce consiste à tirer son A à travers ce portail : le projectile devient surchargé, augmentant ses dégâts, sa vitesse, sa portée et son rayon d'explosion de 40%.

Pour ses combos, commencez en forme à distance avec le A et le E avant d'attaquer. Réinitialisez votre attaque avec le Z puis passez en forme mêlée. Bondissez avec le A, activez le Z, portez deux attaques rapides, puis utilisez le E pour envoyer l'ennemi vers le danger ou loin de vous.
Votre combo d'échange sécurisé consiste à utiliser le A dans le E, attaquer pour réinitialiser votre Z, puis battre en retraite.
